reason: Post-selection population audit: the text candidate still has 38.13% FPR on 8,497 labelled-benign validation homepages. It is not being promoted on aggregate metrics alone. Root-path inputs have a different feature distribution; evaluate a structure-routed expert, not a domain whitelist.
route: Root path: urlsplit(canonical_model_view(url)).path is '/' (empty paths canonicalised to '/'). Same rule during train and inference. Query, userinfo, port and other fields are preserved. No domain-specific routing.
page_expert: Previously chosen converged text model, fixed without further tuning. Used for non-root paths.
fit: Only the existing eligible train rows whose path is root. No new URLs, no label rewriting, no scheme-only inference trick, no A2 test use. Full validation and root strata used only for evaluation/selection.
gate: All earlier integration gates still apply, plus FPR <=20% and dangerous recall >=80% on validation homepages without query. Report the resulting recall loss versus both original A2 format and API format. These are experimental acceptance criteria, not safety standards.
selection: Among passing routed candidates choose lowest whole-validation FPR, tie by higher recall. Demo scores not consulted for choosing the root expert.
limitations: This is exploratory model development informed by validation subgroup diagnostics. Validation is reused and not an unbiased final performance estimate. Root URLs are not assumed benign.
